paper_metadata.title: Serial Diffusion Kurtosis Magnetic Resonance Imaging Study during Acute, Subacute, and Recovery Periods after Sport-Related Concussion

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study uses a large, well-defined prospective cohort of American football players. Recruitment from multiple schools and clear inclusion/exclusion criteria (including 'zero time' within 48h) minimize selection bias. Baseline characteristics are thoroughly reported and balanced between groups.

items.label: Source of target population
items.prompt: The source population or population of interest is adequately described for key characteristics (LIST).
items.evidence_snippet: American football athletes from four high schools and four colleges in southeastern Wisconsin were enrolled for this study between June 2015 and December 2017.
items.reasoning: The population is clearly defined by sport, level (high school/college), and geographic location.

items.label: Method used to identify population
items.prompt: The sampling frame and recruitment are adequately described, including methods to identify the sample sufficient to limit potential bias (number and type used, e.g., referral patterns in health care)
items.evidence_snippet: A total of 1174 athletes were enrolled at pre-season baseline, and completed clinical assessments; 106 of those subjects sustained concussion and were scanned within the first 48 h
items.reasoning: The study uses a prospective design starting from a large baseline pool, which is the gold standard for identifying incident cases.

items.prompt: Period of recruitment is adequately described
items.evidence_snippet: enrolled for this study between June 2015 and December 2017.
items.reasoning: Specific dates are provided.

items.label: Inclusion and exclusion criteria
items.prompt: Inclusion and exclusion criteria are adequately described (e.g., including explicit diagnostic criteria or “zero time” description).
items.evidence_snippet: The definition of concussion proposed by Centers for Disease Control and Prevention HEADS UP educational initiative was used... Participants were excluded... if they reported their injuries outside the 48-h window, had a current diagnosis of psychotic disorder...
items.reasoning: Detailed clinical definitions and specific exclusion criteria (comorbidities, timing) are provided.

items.prompt: There is adequate participation in the study by eligible individuals
items.evidence_snippet: 106 of those subjects sustained concussion and were scanned... 91 control subjects were matched... Ten data sets from the concussed group and nine data sets from the control group were discarded after failing image quality controls
items.reasoning: The study successfully retained the vast majority of eligible concussed athletes from the baseline pool, with minimal loss due to technical factors.

items.reasoning: Standardized equipment and settings were used for all subjects.

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: Outcomes (DKI metrics) are objective physiological measures. The study uses standardized, automated processing pipelines (FSL, TBSS) which limits subjective bias. Reliability (CCC) was pre-tested.

items.label: Definition of the Outcome
items.prompt: A clear definition of outcome is provided, including duration of follow-up and level and extent of the outcome construct.
items.evidence_snippet: derive maps of kurtosis fractional anisotropy (KFA), mean kurtosis (MK), and radial and axial kurtosis (Krad and Kax, respectively).
items.reasoning: The outcomes are clearly defined physical/mathematical constructs from MRI.

items.label: Valid and Reliable Measurement of Outcome
items.prompt: The method of outcome measurement used is adequately valid and reliable to limit misclassification bias (e.g., may include relevant outside sources of information on measurement properties, also characteristics, such as blind measurement and confirmation of outcome with valid and reliable test).
items.evidence_snippet: Average CCC was 0.91 for MD, 0.86 for Krad, and 0.85 for Kax in non-skeletonized DKI maps.
items.reasoning: The authors explicitly report test-retest reliability coefficients for their primary outcomes.

items.label: Method and Setting of Outcome Measurement
items.prompt: The method and setting of outcome measurement is the same for all study participants.
items.evidence_snippet: All participants were scanned on a GE MR750 whole body 3T MRI scanner... Diffusion weighted images for DKI were obtained using a single-shot spin-echo echo-planar imaging (EPI) sequence
items.reasoning: The protocol was identical for all participants.

items.evidence_snippet: Randomise was run with 2000 permutations and the threshold-free cluster enhancement (TFCE) option. Each statistical test was corrected for multiple comparisons using a familywise error (FWE) rate
items.reasoning: The statistical methods are described in high detail.

items.reasoning: The model correctly accounts for the longitudinal nature of the data.
